<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/find-a-job">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobApplication" name="Job application" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ReceiptConfirmed" name="Receipt confirmed and application rated" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PotentialJobOffer" name="Potential job offer" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Probation" name="Probation offer" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" />

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmed and rated" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmAndRate" targetRef="Catch_ApplicationConfirmed" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="SendTask_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Catch_JobOffer" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationOffer" name="Probation offer" sourceRef="SendTask_OfferProbation" targetRef="Catch_ProbationStart" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmPermanent" targetRef="Catch_JobPermanent" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job - Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StartSearch" name="Start job search" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteApplication" name="Write job application" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split parallel activities" />

    <!-- Reporting branch -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Reporting cycle" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportCompanies" name="Report companies applied to" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportCheck" name="Job permanent?" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_NextReport" name="Next regular reporting">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_NextReport" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReportingStopped" name="Reporting stopped" />

    <!-- Confirmation branch -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ApplicationConfirmed" name="Receipt confirmed and application rated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ApplicationConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_ReceiptConfirmed" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationConfirmed" name="Application confirmed" />

    <!-- Offer, interview, probation and permanence branch -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Job offer stream" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JobOffer" name="New potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_JobOffer" messageRef="Msg_PotentialJobOffer" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProbationStart" name="Company wants you to work (probation)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Probation" messageRef="Msg_Probation" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProbation" name="Complete probation phase" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_JobPermanent" messageRef="Msg_JobPermanent" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingCheck" name="Rated company C or less?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JobSearchEnded" name="Job search ended" />

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Reviews">
      <bpmn:text>Reviews for a company can only be seen by job applicants after 1 year.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Reviews" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="TextAnnotation_Reviews" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToWrite" sourceRef="StartEvent_StartSearch" targetRef="Task_WriteApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToSplit" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToReportMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Catch_ApplicationConfirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToOfferMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportMergeToTask" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReportCompanies" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportTaskToCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_ReportCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportCheckToTimer" name="Not yet permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportCheck" targetRef="Timer_NextReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${jobBecamePermanent == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToReportMerge" sourceRef="Timer_NextReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportCheckToStopped" name="Job permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportCheck" targetRef="End_ReportingStopped">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${jobBecamePermanent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToEnd" sourceRef="Catch_ApplicationConfirmed" targetRef="End_ApplicationConfirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferMergeToOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Catch_JobOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToInterview" sourceRef="Catch_JobOffer" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToProbation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Catch_ProbationStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationStartToTask" sourceRef="Catch_ProbationStart" targetRef="Task_CompleteProbation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationTaskToPermanent" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProbation" targetRef="Catch_JobPermanent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentToRate" sourceRef="Catch_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_RateCompany" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateToCheck" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RatingCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCheckToOffers" name="Rated C or less: keep receiving offers" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingCheck" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${ratedCompanyCOrLess == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCheckToEnd" name="Rated above C: process ends" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingCheck" targetRef="End_JobSearchEnded">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${ratedCompanyCOrLess == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Find a Job - Company" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Msg_JobApplication" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of application" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ConfirmAndRate" name="Send receipt confirmation and rating" messageRef="Msg_ReceiptConfirmed" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendJobOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Msg_PotentialJobOffer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OfferProbation" name="Offer probation phase" messageRef="Msg_Probation" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunProbation" name="Run probation phase" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ConfirmPermanent" name="Confirm job becomes permanent" messageRef="Msg_JobPermanent" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_HiringCompleted" name="Hiring completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Task_RateApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="SendTask_ConfirmAndRate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmAndRate" targetRef="SendTask_SendJobOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_6" sourceRef="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview" targetRef="SendTask_OfferProbation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_OfferProbation" targetRef="Task_RunProbation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_8" sourceRef="Task_RunProbation" targetRef="SendTask_ConfirmPermanent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_9" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmPermanent" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_10" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="End_HiringCompleted" />
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
